obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a comprehensive and effective governance system suited to the bank's business
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 34.¹ panta pirmā un 1.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Run a comprehensive and effective governance system suited to the bank's business

summaries.en: A credit institution must set up and operate a comprehensive and effective governance system suited to the nature, scale and complexity of its business. It covers an organisational structure with a clear division of duties, powers and responsibility for carrying out and controlling transactions, a system to identify, manage, monitor and report existing and potential risks including short, medium and long-term ESG risks, internal control procedures, and a remuneration system with a gender-neutral remuneration policy consistent with sound and effective risk management. It must also set up and manage its network and information systems as Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA) and the Law on digital operational resilience and the use of artificial intelligence in the financial market require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep risk strategies, policies and procedures and review them at least every two years
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 34.² panta pirmā, 2.¹ un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Keep risk strategies, policies and procedures and review them at least every two years

summaries.en: A credit institution must draw up, apply and at least every two years review a strategy, policies and procedures to identify, assess, analyse and monitor in good time its credit and counterparty, concentration, securitisation, market, operational, interest rate, credit spread, residual, liquidity and excessive leverage risks and its other material risks, including environmental, social and governance risks and risks from crypto-assets. It must draw up and apply prudential transition plans with quantifiable targets and processes for the financial risks that environmental, social and governance factors create. It must also have plans for emergencies, for restoring liquidity and for business continuity, and set the measures needed to carry them out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cap the variable pay of risk takers at their fixed pay unless the shareholders approve up to twice that
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 34.³ panta otrā, trešā, ceturtā, piektā un sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Cap the variable pay of risk takers at their fixed pay unless the shareholders approve up to twice that

summaries.en: A credit institution may not set the variable remuneration of officers and employees whose work materially affects its risk profile above their fixed remuneration for the year. The shareholders' meeting may by a separate decision allow up to twice the fixed remuneration, on a reasoned draft from the institution, with at least 66 per cent of the voting shares where at least 50 per cent are represented or 75 per cent otherwise, and the persons concerned take no part in the vote. The institution sends Latvijas Banka the draft decision with evidence that it stays able to meet its own funds requirements, and then the decision itself, electronically and within five working days each.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Outsource only under a written contract and notify Latvijas Banka before a significant outsourcing starts
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 10.¹ pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Outsource only under a written contract and notify Latvijas Banka before a significant outsourcing starts

summaries.en: A credit institution may outsource only to a provider with the necessary qualification and experience, under an outsourcing policy and procedures and a written contract, and may not delegate the duties of its management bodies, the taking of deposits or the issue of guarantees; internal audit may be delegated only to a sworn auditor that does not audit its annual accounts or to a parent credit institution registered in a Member State. Before it receives a significant outsourced service it files a reasoned application with Latvijas Banka, the service may start if Latvijas Banka has not prohibited it within 30 working days, and material changes to such a contract are notified at least 30 working days before they take effect. The institution stays liable for the provider's performance as for its own and tells Latvijas Banka at once when a provider of a significant service does not meet the contract.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint suitable members to the management and supervisory boards and remove those who are not
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 24. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Appoint suitable members to the management and supervisory boards and remove those who are not

summaries.en: The chair and the members of a credit institution's management board and supervisory board must have the necessary education and at least three years of relevant professional experience, an impeccable reputation and no ban on commercial activity or on holding office, perform their duties honestly and independently without an unmanaged conflict of interest, and be able to give the role enough time. The two boards as a whole must have sufficient collective knowledge, skills and experience, including of environmental, social and governance factors, and a sufficiently diverse composition. The institution must remove a person who does not meet the requirements without delay, on its own initiative or at the proposal of Latvijas Banka.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep exposures to major shareholders, board members and their families within 20 per cent of own funds
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 43. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Keep exposures to major shareholders, board members and their families within 20 per cent of own funds

summaries.en: A credit institution's exposures to shareholders with a qualifying holding, to members of its supervisory and management boards and heads of its internal control functions, to the spouses, registered partners, parents and children of those persons, and to companies in which they have a qualifying holding may not in total exceed 20 per cent of the own funds used for the large exposure limits under Regulation (EU) No 575/2013. A loan to such a person that alone or in total exceeds 0.1 per cent of those own funds or 50,000 euros, whichever is lower, needs a unanimous decision of the management board. The wording on registered partners applies to exposures entered into from 1 July 2026.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the client's identity, accounts and transactions secret
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 61. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Keep the client's identity, accounts and transactions secret

summaries.en: A credit institution must guarantee the secrecy of a client's identity, accounts, deposits, the financial services used, transactions and its other operations, and may not disclose the information about a client and the client's transactions that it obtains when providing financial services under its contracts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run an effective complaints procedure and answer written complaints within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 74.¹ pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Run an effective complaints procedure and answer written complaints within 30 days

summaries.en: A credit institution must ensure that its procedure for handling clients' applications and complaints (disputes) about its financial services is effective, and keep written information about the procedure freely available at the institution and on its website. It gives a written answer to a written application or complaint within 30 days of receiving it, and may extend that period where objective circumstances prevent meeting it by telling the applicant in writing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep cash withdrawals available through ATMs as Latvijas Banka requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 73.¹ panta otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Keep cash withdrawals available through ATMs as Latvijas Banka requires

summaries.en: A credit institution that is significant for the availability of cash in Latvia (one that serves consumers' payment accounts and holds at least five per cent of the payment accounts and of resident household deposits) must ensure that an ATM of its own or of another such institution is within the distance Latvijas Banka sets from any place in Latvia, keep at least the number of ATMs and the working hours Latvijas Banka sets, and set the ATM interface in Latvian. It gives its clients who are natural persons holding its payment card free cash withdrawals at those ATMs of at least the monthly limit and number of withdrawals Latvijas Banka sets. Where it caps the total amount a client can withdraw at ATMs in a period, it must offer another way to withdraw more.

payload.refLabel: 73.¹ panta otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep financial services reachable for consumers in person and without digital tools
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 163, 24.10.1995.), 73.² panta pirmā, trešā, ceturtā un septītā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 11.11.2026

titles.en: Keep financial services reachable for consumers in person and without digital tools

summaries.en: A credit institution serving consumers in Latvia must offer at least two convenient ways to apply for a financial service, take into account that not every client has or can use electronic identification and distance communication, identify the client groups that need support and tell them about the support and the in-person services available, and set any fee for in-person service in proportion to its actual cost and the same across Latvia. An institution significant for the availability of cash must also provide in person, permanently in the cities and municipal centres that meet the Law's criteria and on request in the others, advice on credit, investment and savings, account opening, closing and servicing, client identification, the paperwork of the relationship and help with transfers. Before it closes a permanent in-person location or materially cuts the services there, it prepares a justification, informs clients, Latvijas Banka and the municipality at least 30 days in advance and gives clients the support they need to find the services elsewhere.

instruments.title: Add Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums, Latvia's law on the financial instrument market and investment services
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026; entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā 2004. gada 1. janvārī) and in its passport on the page

titles.en: Financial Instrument Market Law

payload.implementsNote: MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU, with Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2017/593; the Transparency Directive 2004/109/EC; the Takeover Bids Directive 2004/25/EC (among the directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the bank's investment services in a dedicated unit with safeguards and five-year records
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 124. panta otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Organise the bank's investment services in a dedicated unit with safeguards and five-year records

summaries.en: A credit institution that provides investment or ancillary services must set up dedicated units for them with their own management, internal supervision and audit, led by a person competent in investment matters and of impeccable reputation, and set how the unit's staff may themselves receive investment services. It must keep client and own financial instruments separate at all times, secure the processing, storage and transmission of data, provide the services continuously and systematically, and take the administrative and organisational measures that keep conflicts of interest from harming clients. It keeps the supporting documents of transactions and services for five years, which Latvijas Banka may extend to seven.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record the telephone calls and electronic messages that relate to client orders and own-account dealing
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 124. panta otrās daļas 7. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Record the telephone calls and electronic messages that relate to client orders and own-account dealing

summaries.en: A credit institution providing investment services must keep records of telephone conversations and electronic communications at least for transactions concluded when dealing on own account and for the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, including conversations meant to lead to such a transaction that do not end in one. It takes all reasonable steps to record communications on the devices it provides or has accepted and to prevent the use of private devices it cannot record, and tells clients before providing services that communications will be recorded; without that notice it may not provide order services by telephone. Orders placed through other channels must be in a durable medium, and a face-to-face conversation may be recorded in written minutes or notes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Conclude a written agreement with the client before providing investment services
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 126. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Conclude a written agreement with the client before providing investment services

summaries.en: Before providing investment or ancillary services, an investment firm or credit institution must conclude with the client an agreement, on paper or another durable medium, that sets out the parties' rights and duties and the other terms of the service; these may be set by reference to other documents. Before the agreement is concluded it must tell the client how complaints and disputes arising from it are handled out of court.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess suitability before advising or managing a portfolio and appropriateness before other services
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 126.² pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Assess suitability before advising or managing a portfolio and appropriateness before other services

summaries.en: Before giving investment advice or managing a portfolio, an investment firm or credit institution must obtain information on the client's knowledge and experience, financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance and sustainability preferences, and may not recommend instruments or manage the portfolio without it. For other investment services it asks about knowledge and experience to judge whether the service or product is appropriate, warns the client where it is not or where the information is missing, and may leave the assessment out only for the execution or transmission of orders in non-complex instruments at the client's initiative after a clear warning. The section does not apply to professional clients.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, prevent and manage conflicts of interest under a written policy and disclose those that remain
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 127. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Identify, prevent and manage conflicts of interest under a written policy and disclose those that remain

summaries.en: An investment firm or credit institution must take all appropriate steps to identify and prevent conflicts of interest between itself, its staff, tied agents and controllers and its clients, and between clients, including conflicts caused by third-party inducements or by its own remuneration and incentive arrangements. It adopts and applies a conflicts of interest policy proportionate to its size and business and covering conflicts arising from its group, with procedures such as controls on the exchange of information, separate supervision and the removal of direct links between the pay of persons in conflicting activities, and keeps an updated record of the services in which a conflict damaging to clients has arisen or may arise. Where the arrangements cannot ensure with reasonable confidence that harm to clients will be prevented, it discloses the nature and sources of the conflict and the steps taken to mitigate it to the client in a durable medium before providing the service.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set a target market for the instruments the firm manufactures and distribute only what fits clients' needs
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 128. panta 1.¹, 1.² un 1.³ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Set a target market for the instruments the firm manufactures and distribute only what fits clients' needs

summaries.en: An investment firm or credit institution that manufactures financial instruments for sale must define a target market of end clients for each instrument, make sure the instrument meets that market's needs and that the distribution strategy fits it, and take reasonable steps so that the instrument is distributed to that market. It must understand the instruments it offers or recommends, assess their compatibility with the needs of the clients it serves and offer or recommend them only where that is in the client's interest. The duties do not apply to services in bonds with no embedded derivative other than a make-whole clause, or to instruments marketed or distributed only to eligible counterparties.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give clients fair and clear information on the firm, its instruments, the risks and all costs
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 128. panta piektā, sestā, 6.¹ un septītā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Give clients fair and clear information on the firm, its instruments, the risks and all costs

summaries.en: All information an investment firm or credit institution addresses to clients or potential clients, marketing communications included, must be fair, clear and not misleading, and marketing communications must be clearly identifiable. In good time it tells the client about itself and its services, whether advice is independent and how broad its analysis is, the risks of the instruments and strategies offered and whether an instrument is meant for retail or professional clients, and all costs and charges including third-party payments, aggregated so that the client can understand the overall cost and its cumulative effect on return, with an itemised breakdown on request and at least once a year during the service. The information is free of charge and given in electronic form unless a retail client receives it on paper.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay or accept third-party fees and benefits only where they improve the service and are disclosed
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 128. panta 8.², divpadsmitā, 12.¹ un 12.³ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Pay or accept third-party fees and benefits only where they improve the service and are disclosed

summaries.en: An investment firm or credit institution is treated as breaching its duties to clients if it pays or receives a fee, commission or non-monetary benefit to or from a third party in connection with an investment or ancillary service, unless the payment or benefit is designed to enhance the quality of the service and does not impair its duty to act honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's interest. The existence, nature and amount of the payment or benefit, or the method of calculating it, must be clearly disclosed to the client before the service is provided. When it gives independent advice or manages portfolios it may not accept and keep third-party fees, commissions or benefits at all, apart from minor non-monetary benefits that are clearly disclosed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain the best possible result for the client when executing orders
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 128.² pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Obtain the best possible result for the client when executing orders

summaries.en: When executing client orders, managing portfolios or receiving and transmitting orders, an investment firm or credit institution must obtain the best possible result for the client, taking into account price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size, nature and any other relevant consideration; for a retail client the best result is the total consideration of price and costs. It adopts an order execution policy, may not deal in a client's instruments without the client's consent to that policy, needs prior consent to execute outside a regulated market, MTF or OTF, and must be able to show the client and Latvijas Banka that it followed the policy. A specific instruction from the client is followed and releases the firm from the duty to that extent.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold clients' financial instruments separately, with records reconciled against third-party custodians
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu instrumentu tirgus likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 175, 11.12.2003.), 129.¹ pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 13.11.2026

titles.en: Hold clients' financial instruments separately, with records reconciled against third-party custodians

summaries.en: An investment firm or credit institution may hold a client's financial instruments only under a written agreement and must keep them separate from its own. It may place them with a third party only after assessing that party's competence and reputation with due skill and care, repeats the assessment once a year, and uses only a third party that is subject to rules on segregated holding and to supervision, save in the cases the section lists. It keeps records that distinguish each client's instruments at any time, reconciles them regularly with the third party's records, keeps the registers in double entry, and allows no security interest, lien or right of set-off over client instruments for debts unrelated to the client unless the law of the foreign jurisdiction where they are held requires it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a comprehensive governance system with risk management, internal control and a sound remuneration policy
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 31. panta pirmās daļas 14. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Run a comprehensive governance system with risk management, internal control and a sound remuneration policy

summaries.en: An investment firm must set up and operate a comprehensive and effective governance system suited to the nature, scale and complexity of its business. It covers an organisational structure with a clear, systematic division of duties, powers and responsibility for carrying out and controlling transactions, a system to identify, manage, monitor and report existing and potential risks, internal control procedures, and a remuneration policy and practice that promotes sound and effective risk management and gives women and men equal pay for the same work or work of equal value.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the adequacy of capital and liquid assets continuously and keep a wind-down plan
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 31. panta pirmās daļas 3. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Assess the adequacy of capital and liquid assets continuously and keep a wind-down plan

summaries.en: An investment firm must have a comprehensive, sound and effective strategy and procedures, suited to its business, to assess and maintain on an ongoing basis the amounts, types and distribution of capital and liquid assets it considers adequate for the risks it may pose to others and to which it is or may be exposed, and must review them regularly. As part of that capital and liquidity adequacy assessment process it draws up a wind-down plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep clients' financial instruments and money separate from the firm's own at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 31. panta pirmās daļas 10. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Keep clients' financial instruments and money separate from the firm's own at all times

summaries.en: An investment firm must at all times hold its clients' financial instruments separately from its own financial instruments and its clients' money separately from its own money.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep transaction records for five years and record calls and messages about client orders
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 31. panta pirmās daļas 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Keep transaction records for five years and record calls and messages about client orders

summaries.en: An investment firm must keep the supporting documents of transactions in financial instruments and of its other services for five years, which Latvijas Banka may extend to seven. The same retention applies to recordings of telephone and electronic communications relating to own-account transactions and to the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, including communications that do not end in a transaction. The firm takes all reasonable steps to record communications on devices it provides or has accepted and to prevent the use of private devices, tells clients beforehand that communications will be recorded, and may not take orders by telephone from a client who has not been told.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Outsource only the functions the Law allows and never the management bodies' duties or the whole licensed service
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 34. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Outsource only the functions the Law allows and never the management bodies' duties or the whole licensed service

summaries.en: An investment firm may, with due skill and care and under the procedure of the Financial Instrument Market Law, outsource bookkeeping, the management or development of information and communication technology, the organisation of internal control and the provision of an investment service or a material part of one. Internal audit may be delegated only to a sworn auditor that does not audit the firm's annual accounts or to a parent that is a credit institution, insurer or investment firm registered in a Member State, and portfolio management for retail clients may go to a provider in a third country only if that provider is licensed or registered and supervised at home and Latvijas Banka has an information exchange agreement with its supervisor. The firm may not delegate the duties of its management bodies or hand over the whole of a licensed service.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Latvijas Banka within seven days of board changes and of material changes to licensed services
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 13. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Notify Latvijas Banka within seven days of board changes and of material changes to licensed services

summaries.en: Within seven days of a change in the composition of its management board or supervisory board, an investment firm must notify Latvijas Banka and submit the required information on the new member. It must also notify Latvijas Banka of every material change connected with the investment and ancillary services named in its licence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give employees an independent internal channel for reporting breaches
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 94, 17.05.2022.), 38. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Give employees an independent internal channel for reporting breaches

summaries.en: An investment firm and a branch of a third-country investment firm must make sure that reports of potential and actual breaches of the Law and of Regulation (EU) 2019/2033 are received and examined. It draws up a procedure that sets up an independent and dedicated internal channel through which its employees can report such breaches, and the procedure must meet the Law's rules on protecting the persons who report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 38. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users

summaries.en: A payment institution or electronic money institution must make sure that funds received from payment service users or from another provider for the execution of payments are either covered by an insurance policy or guarantee from an insurer or credit institution outside its own group, or kept separate from the funds of anyone else and out of the assets from which its other creditors are paid. Funds a payment institution still holds at the end of the business day after receipt go to a separate account at a credit institution or a central bank or into safe, liquid, low-risk assets. The institution tells Latvijas Banka the terms of any insurance or guarantee and runs an internal control system that checks compliance continuously.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Latvijas Banka of every circumstance that may materially affect the institution's business
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 47. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Tell Latvijas Banka of every circumstance that may materially affect the institution's business

summaries.en: A payment institution or electronic money institution must inform Latvijas Banka of all circumstances that may materially affect its further operation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the user the framework contract information before the contract is concluded
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 63. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Give the user the framework contract information before the contract is concluded

summaries.en: Before a framework contract is concluded or the payment service user accepts an offer, a payment service provider must give the user, on paper or another durable medium, the information the Law lists for framework contracts. For payment services offered in Latvia the information is given in easily understandable form in Latvian or in another language the parties agree on, and where the contract is concluded at the user's request by a means of distance communication that does not allow this, immediately after conclusion.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Propose changes to a framework contract at least two months before they take effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 66. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Propose changes to a framework contract at least two months before they take effect

summaries.en: A payment service provider must propose changes to a framework contract and to the information and terms given under it on paper or another durable medium no later than two months before the proposed date of application. Where the parties have agreed that silence counts as acceptance, the provider must also state that the user may terminate the contract immediately, free of charge and without penalty, before that date. Changes in interest or exchange rates based on an agreed reference rate may apply without notice, the user is then informed as soon as possible, and the changes may not discriminate between users.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund an unauthorised payment by the end of the next business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 86. panta pirmā, 1.¹ un 1.² daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Refund an unauthorised payment by the end of the next business day

summaries.en: Where a payment was not authorised, the payer's payment service provider must compensate the payer immediately and no later than by the end of the next business day, by refunding the amount or restoring the debited account to the state it would have been in. It may hold back only where it has reasonable grounds to suspect that the user acted unlawfully and has notified Latvijas Banka of the suspicion. Where the payment was initiated through a payment initiation service provider, the account servicing provider makes the refund and is compensated by the initiation provider if that provider is liable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit the payee's provider by the end of the business day after the payment order is received
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 94. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Credit the payee's provider by the end of the business day after the payment order is received

summaries.en: For the payments the chapter covers, payments in euro among them, the payer's payment service provider must make sure that after the payment order is received the amount is credited to the account of the payee's payment service provider no later than by the end of the next business day. The payee's provider then sets the value date and makes the amount available on the payee's payment account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer consumers a basic account and decide on an application within ten business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 97.² pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Offer consumers a basic account and decide on an application within ten business days

summaries.en: A credit institution that provides payment account services to consumers resident in the European Union must also offer a basic account, without conditions such as taking other services. Within ten business days of receiving the application and the information it asks for, it opens the account or refuses; it must refuse where opening or running the account would breach the law, including anti-money laundering rules, or the consumer gave false information, and may refuse where the consumer already holds a payment account with the same services at a credit institution in Latvia. It tells the consumer of a refusal and its reason at once, in writing and free of charge, unless disclosure would conflict with national security or public order, and explains the complaint and out-of-court dispute procedures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer a payment service complaint in full within 15 business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 104. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Answer a payment service complaint in full within 15 business days

summaries.en: A payment service provider or electronic money issuer must run an effective procedure for the applications and complaints of payment service users and electronic money holders, approve a complaints management procedure that checks the facts and detects conflicts of interest, and keep full written information about it freely available on its premises and website. It gives the complainant an exhaustive answer on paper or another agreed durable medium within 15 business days of receipt; where reasons beyond its control prevent this it explains the delay and sets a deadline for the final answer of no more than 35 business days from receipt. It also names at least one out-of-court dispute resolution body competent for disputes under the Law.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage the operational and security risks of payment services within the internal control system
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 104.¹ pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Manage the operational and security risks of payment services within the internal control system

summaries.en: As part of its internal control system, a payment service provider must set up appropriate mitigation measures and control mechanisms to manage the operational and security risks of the payment services it provides. Where Chapter II of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA) does not apply to it, it also sets up and maintains effective procedures for managing information system security incidents, including the detection and classification of major operational and security incidents. A licensed institution sets up and manages its network and information systems as that Regulation and the Law on digital operational resilience require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply strong customer authentication to online account access and payment initiation
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Maksājumu pakalpojumu un elektroniskās naudas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 43, 17.03.2010.), 104.⁴ pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Apply strong customer authentication to online account access and payment initiation

summaries.en: A payment service provider must apply strong customer authentication when the payer accesses a payment account online, initiates a payment or carries out through a remote channel any action that may involve a risk of payment fraud or other abuse. For electronic remote payments the authentication must dynamically link the transaction to a specific amount and a specific payee, and the provider must protect the confidentiality and integrity of users' personalised security credentials. The exemptions of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/389 may be used.

instruments.title: Add Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums, Latvia's anti-money laundering law
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 13.08.2008.); the act has no entry-into-force provision of its own

titles.lv: Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums
titles.en: Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing

payload.officialRef: Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document a risk assessment and build the internal control system on it
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 6. panta pirmā, 1.¹ un 1.² daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Document a risk assessment and build the internal control system on it

summaries.en: An obliged entity must carry out and document, in line with the type and scale of its business, an assessment of its money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risks, and on that basis set up an internal control system with documented policies and procedures approved by its management board or highest management body. The assessment takes into account the risks named in the EU and the national risk assessments and at least customer risk, country and geographic risk, the risk of the products and services used and the risk of the delivery channels.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint the officers responsible for compliance and notify the supervisor within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 10. panta pirmā, otrā un 2.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Appoint the officers responsible for compliance and notify the supervisor within 30 days

summaries.en: An obliged entity that is a legal person must appoint one or more employees, including from senior management, who may take decisions and are directly responsible for compliance with the Law and for the exchange of information with the supervisory and control authority, and must notify that authority within 30 days of becoming an obliged entity or of a change among them. Credit institutions, licensed payment and electronic money institutions, investment firms and crypto-asset service providers appoint such a person both in senior management, to oversee compliance, and in the internal control unit, to carry it out. Unless other rules provide otherwise, the entity also adopts a policy for assessing these persons and a procedure dividing their powers and duties and overseeing their work.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out customer due diligence before a business relationship and before the occasional transactions the Law lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 11. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Carry out customer due diligence before a business relationship and before the occasional transactions the Law lists

summaries.en: An obliged entity must carry out customer due diligence before establishing a business relationship, and before an occasional transaction of 15,000 euros or more in one or several linked operations, a transfer of funds of 1,000 euros or more, a currency exchange above 1,500 euros or a lower amount the entity sets, or a crypto-asset transaction of 1,000 euros or more. It must also do so whenever it suspects money laundering or terrorism or proliferation financing, or doubts that the due diligence data obtained earlier are true or adequate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Establish the customer's beneficial owner and verify it from a reliable and independent source
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 18. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Establish the customer's beneficial owner and verify it from a reliable and independent source

summaries.en: Whenever customer due diligence is required, an obliged entity must establish the customer's beneficial owner and take risk-based measures to make sure that the person established really is the beneficial owner, using a reliable and independent source of information. It obtains at least the person's name, personal identity number or date of birth, nationality and country of permanent residence, the share of the customer's capital or shares held or controlled directly or indirectly and the kind of control exercised, and, where control is indirect, the details of the person or entity through which it is exercised.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep customer information up to date and monitor transactions throughout the relationship
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 20. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Keep customer information up to date and monitor transactions throughout the relationship

summaries.en: After a business relationship starts or when carrying out occasional transactions, an obliged entity must, on the basis of its risk assessment, continuously update the information on the customer's economic or personal activity and monitor the customer's activity and transactions to make sure they are not suspicious. It examines the nature and purpose of transactions and applies enhanced monitoring to a transaction that is unusually large for the customer, complex, apparently linked to others or without apparent economic or clearly lawful purpose, and to a transaction involving a person from a high-risk third country.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence where the Law requires it or the risk is higher
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 22. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence where the Law requires it or the risk is higher

summaries.en: An obliged entity must apply enhanced due diligence when the customer was not present in person for identification, unless the Law's conditions for remote identification are met, when the customer is a politically exposed person, a family member or a close associate, in correspondent relationships with a credit or financial institution, when the customer transfers crypto-assets to or from a self-hosted address, and in any other case of higher risk. The measures, chosen on a risk basis, include obtaining and assessing further information on the customer, the beneficial owner, the intended nature of the relationship and the origin of funds and wealth, senior management approval for starting or continuing the relationship, and more frequent and deeper monitoring.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Find out whether a customer or beneficial owner is a politically exposed person and apply the added measures
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 25. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Find out whether a customer or beneficial owner is a politically exposed person and apply the added measures

summaries.en: When starting a business relationship an obliged entity must establish, by risk-based measures, whether the customer or its beneficial owner is a politically exposed person, a family member of one or a close associate, and its internal control system must be able to detect when a customer becomes one later. Where that is so, it obtains senior management approval before starting the relationship, takes and documents risk-based measures to establish the origin of the funds and of the wealth of the customer and the beneficial owner, and monitors the customer's transactions on an enhanced basis throughout the relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report every suspicious transaction to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 31.⁴ panta pirmā, otrā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Report every suspicious transaction to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay

summaries.en: An obliged entity must register in the Financial Intelligence Unit's data receipt and analysis system and report every suspicious transaction through it without delay, including funds suspected of being proceeds of crime or linked to terrorism or proliferation financing that have not yet been used in a transaction, and must file threshold declarations in the cases the Cabinet of Ministers sets. On the Unit's request it supplies the information and documents it holds within seven working days, or within three working days where the request is urgent or linked to a temporary freezing order. It gives its supervisory and control authority access to the reports and declarations it has filed.

payload.refLabel: 31.⁴ panta pirmā, otrā un ceturtā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refrain from a transaction suspected of money laundering and report it by the next working day
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 32. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Refrain from a transaction suspected of money laundering and report it by the next working day

summaries.en: An obliged entity must decide to refrain from carrying out a transaction that is linked, or is reasonably suspected of being linked, to money laundering or to terrorism or proliferation financing, or where there are reasonable suspicions that the funds are proceeds of crime. It reports the decision to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay and no later than the next working day, and takes no action with the funds involved until the Unit orders the refraining to end or issues a freezing order.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep due diligence and transaction records for five years after the relationship ends, then destroy them
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 116, 30.07.2008.), 37. panta otrā, 2.¹ un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Keep due diligence and transaction records for five years after the relationship ends, then destroy them

summaries.en: For five years after a business relationship ends or an occasional transaction is carried out, an obliged entity must keep all information obtained in customer due diligence, including copies of identification documents, the results of due diligence and analyses, the information from transaction monitoring, information on all the customer's payments and its correspondence with the customer. When the period ends it destroys the documents and information it holds on the person, unless an authority named in the section has extended the period, which it may do by up to five more years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Observe and carry out international and national sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Starptautisko un Latvijas Republikas nacionālo sankciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 31, 15.02.2016.), 2. panta otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Observe and carry out international and national sanctions

summaries.en: The Law applies to all persons, and every person must observe and carry out international and national sanctions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds of a person under national financial restrictions at once and make nothing available to them
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Starptautisko un Latvijas Republikas nacionālo sankciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 31, 15.02.2016.), 5. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Freeze the funds of a person under national financial restrictions at once and make nothing available to them

summaries.en: Where national sanctions impose financial restrictions on a sanctioned person, every person must within its competence, immediately and without prior warning, freeze all funds and economic resources that the sanctioned person, or third parties acting on its behalf or at its direction, own, hold or control directly or indirectly, in whole or in part. It must not make funds or economic resources available to them or for their benefit, directly or indirectly, and must not provide them the financial services the national sanctions name.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document a sanctions risk assessment and set up an internal control system for sanctions risk
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Starptautisko un Latvijas Republikas nacionālo sankciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 31, 15.02.2016.), 13.¹ pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Document a sanctions risk assessment and set up an internal control system for sanctions risk

summaries.en: A person supervised by Latvijas Banka or by another of the supervisors the section names must carry out and document, in line with its type of business, an assessment of international and national sanctions risk, so as to identify, assess, understand and manage the risk that sanctions on its business or its customers are not carried out. On that basis it sets up an internal control system for managing sanctions risk, with documented policies and procedures, adequate resources and staff training.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report a suspected breach or attempted breach of sanctions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Starptautisko un Latvijas Republikas nacionālo sankciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 31, 15.02.2016.), 17. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Report a suspected breach or attempted breach of sanctions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay

summaries.en: A person supervised by one of the sanctions supervisory authorities must report to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay, under the procedure of the anti-money laundering law, when a suspicion arises that international or national sanctions have been breached or that a breach was attempted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the Financial Intelligence Unit at once of every freeze and other step taken to carry out sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Starptautisko un Latvijas Republikas nacionālo sankciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 31, 15.02.2016.), 12. panta piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Tell the Financial Intelligence Unit at once of every freeze and other step taken to carry out sanctions

summaries.en: Every person must inform the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay of how it has carried out international and national sanctions, including any freezing of funds, as soon as the freeze is made.

instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kontu reģistra likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 10.12.2016.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026; entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā 2017. gada 1. jūlijā) and in its passport on the page

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send account and safe deposit box data to the account register at least every two working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kontu reģistra likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 10.12.2016.), 5. panta pirmā, otrā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Send account and safe deposit box data to the account register at least every two working days

summaries.en: A credit institution, credit union or payment service provider must supply the account register, electronically through the state data distribution network and at least once every two working days, with its own name and registration number and, for each demand deposit, payment or investment account and each safe deposit box service, the holder's identifying details, the account number or box identifier and the dates of opening and closing. The identifying details differ for resident and non-resident natural and legal persons as the section lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the beneficial owner and any authorised person together with the account data
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kontu reģistra likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 10.12.2016.), 5. panta trešā un 3.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Report the beneficial owner and any authorised person together with the account data

summaries.en: Where a beneficial owner of the account holder or box user has been established, the data supplier must report with the account data the beneficial owner's name and personal identity number, or for a non-resident the date of birth and the number and issuing country of an identity document. Where a person authorised to operate the account has been established, the same details are reported for that person.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report openings, closings and changes of data, and answer for the accuracy of what is reported
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kontu reģistra likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 10.12.2016.), 5. panta piektā, sestā un astotā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Report openings, closings and changes of data, and answer for the accuracy of what is reported

summaries.en: The data supplier must report when an account is opened or closed and when a safe deposit box lease is concluded or ended, and whenever it learns of a change in the data of the account holder, box user, beneficial owner or authorised person. It is responsible for the reported data matching the information it holds, and reports in Latvian, with the names of foreign persons in Latin transliteration.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Mark in the register whether an account was closed with a balance and clear the mark when it no longer holds
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kontu reģistra likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 10.12.2016.), 5. panta 2.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Mark in the register whether an account was closed with a balance and clear the mark when it no longer holds

summaries.en: When the data supplier reports an account's closing date it must state whether the account was closed with a balance. When the circumstances or the basis for the status of an account closed with a balance no longer exist, it must change the status to closed without that mark. The rule is applied no later than 1 July 2026, and to entries already in the register by 30 September 2026.

instruments.title: Add Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums, Latvia's law on investment management companies and investment funds (UCITS)
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025; entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā 1998. gada 1. jūlijā) and in its passport on the page

titles.en: Law on Investment Management Companies

payload.implementsNote: UCITS Directive 2009/65/EC, with UCITS V, Directive 2014/91/EU, and Directive (EU) 2019/1160 on cross-border distribution of funds (among the directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage funds fairly, with due care and only in the interests of the fund and its investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 13.¹ panta pirmā, 1.¹, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Manage funds fairly, with due care and only in the interests of the fund and its investors

summaries.en: When providing management services, a management company must act fairly, independently of the custodian bank and as an honest and careful manager, with due professionalism and diligence and only in the interests of the fund, its investors and the recipients of the services, without endangering financial market stability; it may not act as management company and custodian bank at once. It uses clear, precise and transparent valuation methods, charges no unjustified costs, treats the investors of the funds it manages equally and fairly, and keeps a procedure that prevents malpractice affecting market stability or the fair treatment of other investors.

payload.refLabel: 13.¹ panta pirmā, 1.¹, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take or make third-party payments only where they are disclosed and improve the service
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 13.¹ panta piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Take or make third-party payments only where they are disclosed and improve the service

summaries.en: In managing or administering an investment fund, a state funded pension scheme investment plan or a private pension fund's pension plan, a management company may not make or receive payments or other benefits. The exceptions are those paid by or to the recipient of the service, those from or to a third party whose existence, nature and amount or method of calculation were explained to the recipient fully, accurately and understandably beforehand and which are meant to raise the quality of the service without affecting the duty to act in clients' interests, and those necessary for providing the service, such as custody, settlement and trading venue costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the complaints procedure and answer fund investors' written complaints within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 13.⁵ panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Publish the complaints procedure and answer fund investors' written complaints within 30 days

summaries.en: A management company must keep its procedure for handling fund investors' applications and complaints (disputes) freely available at its premises and on its website, and let investors and potential investors file them free of charge. It answers a written application or complaint in writing within 30 days of receipt, and may extend the period where objective circumstances prevent meeting it by telling the applicant in writing.

payload.refLabel: 13.⁵ panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep internal controls that minimise conflicts of interest between the company, its clients and its funds
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 14. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un 3.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Keep internal controls that minimise conflicts of interest between the company, its clients and its funds

summaries.en: A management company must keep an internal control system that minimises the possibility of conflicts of interest between itself and its clients, between the funds it manages, between its clients, and between clients and funds. To identify the kinds of conflict it considers the situations in which it, a related person or a controller could gain or avoid a loss at the fund's expense, has an interest in an outcome that differs from the fund's, is induced to favour another client, or receives a non-standard benefit from someone other than the fund, and it also considers conflicts that arise from integrating sustainability risks into its processes.

payload.refLabel: 14. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un 3.¹ daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Delegate fund management services only under a delegation policy filed with Latvijas Banka beforehand
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 15. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā, piektā un sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Delegate fund management services only under a delegation policy filed with Latvijas Banka beforehand

summaries.en: A management company may delegate individual fund management services by contract only to a person with suitable qualification and experience, and investment management only to another management company or a provider licensed in another Member State, never to an interested person of the custodian bank or of the company or to anyone whose interests may conflict with those of the company or the investors. Before delegating it adopts a delegation policy and procedure covering the decision, the conclusion, monitoring and ending of the contract, the responsible persons, risk management and what it does if the provider fails, and submits them to Latvijas Banka. Where investment management is delegated it also files a reasoned application and the delegation contract.

payload.refLabel: 15. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā, piektā un sestā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give every interested person the fund prospectus and key investor information free of charge
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 58. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Give every interested person the fund prospectus and key investor information free of charge

summaries.en: A management company must make the fund prospectus and the key investor information available free of charge to all interested persons, by placing them on its website or using a durable medium, and give investors a paper copy free of charge on request. When either document is amended it must without delay after the amendments take effect publish on its website the full prospectus showing the amendments and their effective date and the latest key investor information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Redeem fund units at the investor's request and suspend redemption only in exceptional cases
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 54. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Redeem fund units at the investor's request and suspend redemption only in exceptional cases

summaries.en: The management company of a fund must redeem the fund's units when an investor asks, paying the redemption price in money out of the fund's assets under the terms and within the time the prospectus sets, in the order in which requests are filed. It may suspend redemption only in the cases and under the procedure the prospectus sets, in exceptional circumstances where the suspension is justified in the investors' interests. It is released from the duty where the units are traded on a regulated market and it takes steps to keep the market price close to the unit value.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As custodian bank, safeguard the fund's assets and check that the company acts within the law and the fund rules
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 42. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: As custodian bank, safeguard the fund's assets and check that the company acts within the law and the fund rules

summaries.en: A custodian bank must keep the fund's assets under the Law and the custodian contract, and ensure that the issue, sale, redemption and cancellation of units, the calculation of their value and the use of the fund's income follow the Law, the prospectus and the fund rules. It carries out the management company's instructions unless they conflict with those, makes sure payment due to the fund in transactions arrives on time, gives Latvijas Banka the information it asks for, and brings investors' claims against the company in its own name where the circumstances require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As custodian bank, report the management company's unlawful conduct to Latvijas Banka at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ieguldījumu pārvaldes sabiedrību likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 342/346, 30.12.1997.), 45. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: As custodian bank, report the management company's unlawful conduct to Latvijas Banka at once

summaries.en: A custodian bank must report without delay to Latvijas Banka and to the management company's supervisory board any conduct of the company known to it that conflicts with the Law, the fund prospectus, the fund rules or the custodian contract.

instruments.title: Add Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums, Latvia's law on alternative investment funds and their managers
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 07.08.2013.); the act has no entry-into-force provision of its own

titles.en: Law on Alternative Investment Funds and Their Managers
