payload.officialRef: Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.)
payload.implementsNote: AIFMD, Directive 2011/61/EU, with Directive (EU) 2019/1160 on cross-border distribution of funds (among the six directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage each fund honestly and carefully in the interests of the fund and its investors, treating investors equally
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 22. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Manage each fund honestly and carefully in the interests of the fund and its investors, treating investors equally

summaries.en: During the life of its licence a manager must make sure the rules governing it and its funds are met, act as an honest and careful manager with due professionalism and diligence in the interests of the fund and its investors without endangering the stability and integrity of the financial market, and take all necessary steps to identify and prevent conflicts of interest or, where they cannot be prevented, to manage them. It treats the investors of a fund equally and fairly, favouring none unless the fund's founding document or rules provide for different treatment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the staff, systems and records that allow every fund transaction to be reconstructed
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 22. panta otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Keep the staff, systems and records that allow every fund transaction to be reconstructed

summaries.en: A manager must have the staff and technology its business needs, a website and effective procedures, including the procedure for personal transactions, own-account dealing and dealing in fund units. It keeps accounting records and administrative procedures suited to its services and an electronic data storage, protection and control mechanism that allows transactions with fund money to be reconstructed by origin, parties, nature, time and place, and monitors that fund investments follow the fund rules and the Law. It maintains its network and information systems as Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA) and the Law on digital operational resilience require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Limit conflicts of interest and tell investors about those that cannot be prevented
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 23. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Limit conflicts of interest and tell investors about those that cannot be prevented

summaries.en: A manager must take all necessary measures to reduce the possibility of conflicts of interest between itself, its officers, employees or controllers and the funds it manages or their investors, between funds, between clients and between funds and other clients. Before it starts managing a fund it informs the fund's investors of its activities that may cause other material conflicts and, where its preventive measures are in its view not enough to prevent harm to investors, of the nature and causes of the conflict. Where it uses a prime broker for a fund it sets specific contract terms for the transfer and reuse of fund assets and informs the fund's custodian bank of the contract.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a risk management system for each fund, review it at least once a year and keep risk control separate
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 25. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā un piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Run a risk management system for each fund, review it at least once a year and keep risk control separate

summaries.en: A manager must set up a risk management system to identify, measure, manage and monitor all risks linked to each fund's investment strategy, without relying mechanically or solely on external credit ratings, and assess its effectiveness regularly and at least once a year. The risk control function must be organisationally and functionally separate from the activity it controls unless the manager shows Latvijas Banka that independence is otherwise secured. The manager applies documented and regularly reviewed due diligence when investing for a fund and monitors all investment risks and their combined effect continuously, including by stress tests suited to the fund.

payload.refLabel: 25. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā un piektā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a liquidity management system with regular stress tests for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 26. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Run a liquidity management system with regular stress tests for each fund

summaries.en: For each fund it manages, a manager must set up a liquidity management system suited to the fund and procedures to monitor the fund's liquidity risk and to keep the liquidity of its investments in line with its obligations. It carries out stress tests regularly, also under exceptional liquidity conditions, and makes sure the fund's investment strategy, liquidity profile and redemption policy are consistent with each other. The section does not apply to closed-ended funds that use no leverage.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the complaints procedure and answer alternative fund investors' written complaints within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 29. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Publish the complaints procedure and answer alternative fund investors' written complaints within 30 days

summaries.en: A manager must keep its procedure for handling fund investors' applications and complaints (disputes) freely available at its premises and on its website; a registered manager may instead set the procedure out in the fund's founding document. Investors and potential investors may file applications and complaints free of charge, and the manager answers a written one in writing within 30 days of receipt, a period it may extend where objective circumstances prevent meeting it by telling the applicant in writing.

payload.refLabel: 29. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each fund's assets, risk profile, liquidity and leverage to Latvijas Banka
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 59. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: Report each fund's assets, risk profile, liquidity and leverage to Latvijas Banka

summaries.en: A manager registered in Latvia must give Latvijas Banka the statistical information and the information Article 110(1) of Delegated Regulation (EU) No 231/2013 requires, in the form of its Annex IV. A licensed manager also reports for each fund the share of illiquid assets under special arrangements, changes in liquidity management methods, the risk profile and risk management systems, the main asset types and the results of its stress tests. For each fund using leverage on a substantial basis it reports the overall level of leverage and its breakdown by source and the five largest lenders of cash or securities with the amounts borrowed.

payload.refLabel: 59. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: As custodian bank of an alternative investment fund, hold its assets and check the manager's instructions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Alternatīvo ieguldījumu fondu un to pārvaldnieku likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 142, 24.07.2013.), 48. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.06.2026

titles.en: As custodian bank of an alternative investment fund, hold its assets and check the manager's instructions

summaries.en: A custodian bank must hold the assets of the fund, or of the manager acting for the fund, under the Law, Delegated Regulation (EU) No 231/2013 and the custodian contract, and ensure that the issue, sale and redemption of units, the calculation of their value, payments in transactions with fund assets and the use of the fund's income follow the Law, the Regulation and the fund rules. It carries out the manager's instructions unless they conflict with those, gives Latvijas Banka the information it asks for, and brings investors' claims against the manager in its own name where the circumstances require. It is fully liable to investors and the manager for losses caused by an intentional or negligent breach of the Law or the contract by it or by a person holding instruments for it.

instruments.title: Add Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums, Latvia's law on insurance and reinsurance undertakings (Solvency II)
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 01.07.2015.) and in its closing provision, which puts it into force on the day after its promulgation

titles.en: Insurance and Reinsurance Law

payload.implementsNote: Solvency II, Directive 2009/138/EC; the Financial Conglomerates Directive 2002/87/EC (among the directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a governance system with written policies filed with Latvijas Banka and reviewed every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 53. panta pirmā, otrā, ceturtā un piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Run a governance system with written policies filed with Latvijas Banka and reviewed every year

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking must set up and operate a comprehensive and effective system of governance suited to the nature, scale and complexity of its business, with a transparent organisational structure and a clear allocation of duties, powers and responsibility, an effective system for passing on information and regular monitoring of the system. It adopts at least policies and procedures on risk management, internal control, internal audit and, where it outsources, outsourcing, submits them to Latvijas Banka in writing within 10 days of approval and tells it of every change. At least once a year it assesses compliance with them and their fit with its business, and improves them without delay after a material change in the business.

payload.refLabel: 53. panta pirmā, otrā, ceturtā un piektā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out and document a stress test at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 55. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Carry out and document a stress test at least once a year

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking must carry out a stress test at least once a year in which it assesses and documents possible development scenarios, using sensitivity analysis for the effect of an adverse change in a single risk factor and scenario analysis for simultaneous adverse changes in several. Its management board adopts the procedure for the stress test in view of the material risks and their risk factors and is responsible for it being followed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run an effective risk management system that covers every risk in and outside the solvency capital requirement
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 64. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Run an effective risk management system that covers every risk in and outside the solvency capital requirement

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking must set up and operate an effective risk management system, built into its organisational structure and decision-making, that identifies, measures, monitors, manages and reports in good time the individual and interdependent risks to which it is or could be exposed, and adopt a risk management strategy, methods and an internal information procedure. The management board makes sure the system covers all risks included in the calculation of the Solvency Capital Requirement and the material risks that the calculation does not cover or does not cover in full.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out an own risk and solvency assessment at least once a year and after any material change in risk profile
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 65. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Carry out an own risk and solvency assessment at least once a year and after any material change in risk profile

summaries.en: As part of its risk management system, an insurance or reinsurance undertaking must carry out an own risk and solvency assessment at least once a year and without delay after any material change in its risk profile. The assessment covers its overall solvency needs in view of its risk profile, approved risk tolerance limits and business strategy, with documented methods that capture short and long-term effects, continuous compliance with the capital requirements and the rules on technical provisions, and how far its risk profile departs from the assumptions behind its Solvency Capital Requirement calculation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep information about policyholders and insured persons confidential
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 84. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Keep information about policyholders and insured persons confidential

summaries.en: Unless a law provides otherwise, an insurer must not disclose information about a policyholder or an insured person. To reduce its operational risk and prevent fraud, insurers may exchange information on policyholders, insured persons and insurance contracts in force with each other, directly or through a body set up for the purpose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Latvijas Banka at least 30 days before outsourcing a critical function and never outsource the core
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 73. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Notify Latvijas Banka at least 30 days before outsourcing a critical function and never outsource the core

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking may outsource what its business needs, but not the duties of its management bodies, the issue of guarantees or all of the services that make up its licensed insurance or reinsurance business. Internal audit may be delegated only to a sworn auditor that does not audit its annual accounts or to a parent that is an insurer of a Member State. At least 30 days before outsourcing a critical or important function or activity, as Latvijas Banka defines them, it files a reasoned written application with its outsourcing policy, its procedure for monitoring outsourcing quality and the draft contract, and it submits later amendments to these before approving them.

payload.refLabel: 73. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Latvijas Banka at once of any change in qualifying holdings in the undertaking
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 79. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Notify Latvijas Banka at once of any change in qualifying holdings in the undertaking

summaries.en: As soon as it learns of it, an insurance or reinsurance undertaking must notify Latvijas Banka in writing of any person's acquisition, increase or reduction of a qualifying holding, stating the size of the holding as a percentage of its share capital or voting shares, or that the qualifying holding has ended.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish a solvency and financial condition report every year and public quarterly reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 124, 30.06.2015.), 91. panta pirmā, otrā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2025

titles.en: Publish a solvency and financial condition report every year and public quarterly reports

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking must publish every year a report on its solvency and financial condition, with qualitative and quantitative, past, present and planned data and information from internal and external sources, as Latvijas Banka's requirements set out. An insurance undertaking also prepares public quarterly reports that inform the public of its business and financial indicators, with at least the content Latvijas Banka sets.

instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 23.05.2019.); the act has no entry-into-force provision of its own

titles.en: Insurance and Reinsurance Distribution Law

payload.officialRef: Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Start distributing insurance only after registration in the register for the firm's kind of intermediary
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 5. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, piektā un sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Start distributing insurance only after registration in the register for the firm's kind of intermediary

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance broker may start distribution only after it is entered in the brokers' register kept by Latvijas Banka, an insurance agent only after it is entered in the agents' register kept by the insurer or the branch of a foreign insurer it acts for, and an ancillary insurance intermediary only after it is entered in the register for ancillary intermediaries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's best interests when distributing insurance
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 33. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's best interests when distributing insurance

summaries.en: An insurance distributor must always act honestly, fairly and professionally in accordance with the best interests of its customers. All information it addresses to customers about distribution, marketing communications included, must be fair, clear and not misleading. It may not be remunerated, or remunerate or assess the performance of its employees, in a way that conflicts with its duty to act in the customer's interest.

payload.refLabel: 33. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Establish the customer's demands and needs and give objective product information before the contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 36. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, piektā un sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Establish the customer's demands and needs and give objective product information before the contract

summaries.en: Before an insurance contract is concluded, an insurance distributor must establish the customer's demands and needs from the information the customer gives and provide objective information about the insurance product in a comprehensible form, so that the customer can make an informed decision, and any contract it proposes must be consistent with those demands and needs. Where it gives advice it provides a personalised recommendation explaining why the product best meets them. For the non-life classes the information is given in the standardised insurance product information document, on paper or another durable medium.

payload.refLabel: 36. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, piektā un sestā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the customer when the parts of a package can be bought separately and what each costs
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 40. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Tell the customer when the parts of a package can be bought separately and what each costs

summaries.en: Where an insurance product is offered together with an ancillary product or service that is not insurance, as part of a package or the same agreement, the insurance distributor must tell the customer whether the components can be bought separately and give a description of each component and its price and costs. Where the risk or the insurance cover differs because of the combination, it describes the components and how their interaction changes the risk or the cover. Where insurance is ancillary to a good or service that is not insurance, it offers the customer the possibility of buying the good or service separately, save for the exceptions the section lists.

payload.refLabel: 40. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Approve each insurance product for a defined target market and review it regularly
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 41. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā un piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Approve each insurance product for a defined target market and review it regularly

summaries.en: An insurer, a branch of a foreign insurer or an intermediary that manufactures insurance products for sale must, before distribution, maintain and review a proportionate process for approving each product and each significant adaptation of an existing one, which identifies the target market, assesses all relevant risks to it and makes sure the intended distribution strategy fits it. The products and the target market are reviewed regularly, and the manufacturer makes all appropriate information on the product, its approval and its target market available to distributors. A distributor that sells products it does not manufacture has arrangements to obtain that information and to understand each product and its target market.

payload.refLabel: 41. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā un piektā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prevent conflicts of interest from harming customers of insurance-based investment products and disclose those that remain
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 42. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā un piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Prevent conflicts of interest from harming customers of insurance-based investment products and disclose those that remain

summaries.en: An insurer, a branch of a foreign insurer or an insurance intermediary that distributes insurance-based investment products must maintain effective and proportionate organisational and administrative arrangements to prevent conflicts of interest from adversely affecting its customers' interests, and take all appropriate steps to identify conflicts between itself, its managers, employees or closely linked persons and its customers, or between customers. Where the arrangements are not sufficient to prevent the risk of harm to the customer, it discloses the nature or source of the conflict to the customer in a durable medium in good time before the contract is concluded.

payload.refLabel: 42. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā un piektā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess suitability or appropriateness before selling an insurance-based investment product
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 44. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Assess suitability or appropriateness before selling an insurance-based investment product

summaries.en: When advising on an insurance-based investment product, an insurer, a branch of a foreign insurer or an insurance intermediary must obtain the customer's knowledge and experience in the investment field relevant to the product, financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance, so that what it recommends is suitable. Where it sells without advice it asks for the customer's knowledge and experience relevant to the product or service offered or demanded, to assess whether it is appropriate. Where the product is bundled with another product or service that is not insurance, the overall package must be suitable or appropriate.

payload.refLabel: 44. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give staff directly involved in insurance distribution at least 15 hours of training a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 23. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Give staff directly involved in insurance distribution at least 15 hours of training a year

summaries.en: The responsible persons of an intermediary and the employees directly involved in insurance or reinsurance distribution must keep their knowledge and skills up to date and complete at least 15 hours a year of training organised or recognised by the distributor or by an association of insurance distributors and suited to the distributor, the products and the role. An insurer or reinsurer, or a branch of a foreign one, provides that training for its own staff directly involved in distribution.

payload.refLabel: 23. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer a customer's complaint about insurance distribution in writing within 20 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Apdrošināšanas un pārapdrošināšanas izplatīšanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 91, 09.05.2019.), 46. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.12.2025

titles.en: Answer a customer's complaint about insurance distribution in writing within 20 days

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance distributor must run an effective complaints procedure, approved by its management board, that covers how complaints are examined, how the facts are checked and how conflicts of interest are avoided, and keep written information about it freely available where it provides its services and on its website. It gives a reasoned written answer within 20 days of the complaint being filed; where objective reasons prevent this it explains why more time is needed and sets a reasonable deadline. A complaint about another market participant that it may not examine is forwarded to that participant within seven days and the customer is told.

payload.refLabel: 46. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā un ceturtā daļa

instruments.title: Add Noguldījumu garantiju likums, Latvia's deposit guarantee law
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026; entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā 2015. gada 1. jūlijā) and in its passport on the page

titles.en: Deposit Guarantee Law

payload.implementsNote: DGSD, Directive 2014/49/EU; BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU (the directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay a quarterly contribution to the deposit guarantee fund based on covered deposits
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), 8. panta trešā, ceturtā, 4.² un sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026

titles.en: Pay a quarterly contribution to the deposit guarantee fund based on covered deposits

summaries.en: A credit institution registered in Latvia, a credit union and the Latvian branch of a credit institution registered in a third country must pay the deposit guarantee fund once a quarter up to 0.05 per cent of the average balance of covered deposits it held in the previous quarter, multiplied by a risk adjustment coefficient calculated as Latvijas Banka sets. A branch of a Member State credit institution that takes part in the fund pays up to 0.05 per cent of the average covered deposits the branch held. Payments are made in euros, and Latvijas Banka may raise the quarterly rate to up to 0.125 per cent with at least three months' notice.

payload.refLabel: 8. panta trešā, ceturtā, 4.² un sestā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep records of eligible deposits updated at least daily and hand them to Latvijas Banka within one working day
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), 17. panta pirmā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026

titles.en: Keep records of eligible deposits updated at least daily and hand them to Latvijas Banka within one working day

summaries.en: A deposit taker must hold in its accounting records at all times the information on eligible deposits, their depositors and the amount of covered deposits, and update it at least once a day so that the records show the current amount of guaranteed compensation. It submits the information within one working day of a request from Latvijas Banka. At least once every three years its internal audit checks the recording of eligible and covered deposits, on a risk-based approach.

payload.refLabel: 17. panta pirmā, trešā un ceturtā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the sworn auditor check the covered deposit and contribution report every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), 12. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026

titles.en: Have the sworn auditor check the covered deposit and contribution report every year

summaries.en: A credit institution or its branch must make sure that once a year, when auditing the annual accounts, the sworn auditor also checks whether the deposit taker's report on covered deposits and on payments to the deposit guarantee fund was prepared as the rules require. The auditor submits a written report on the check to Latvijas Banka.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give each depositor the deposit guarantee information sheet before the relationship starts
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), 28. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026

titles.en: Give each depositor the deposit guarantee information sheet before the relationship starts

summaries.en: Before starting a business relationship with a depositor, a deposit taker must give information on the amount of guaranteed compensation, the procedure and time limit for paying it, the possibility of set-off and the contact details of the deposit guarantee fund, on the form Latvijas Banka approves, and obtain the depositor's acknowledgement of receipt. It confirms to the depositor whether the deposit is an eligible deposit, through the internet bank or another suitable channel, or in writing on request where the depositor has no internet bank. It keeps the form available through its remote services, or hands it over on paper once a year on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell depositors of a reorganisation, liquidation or exclusion from the deposit guarantee fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), 29. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026

titles.en: Tell depositors of a reorganisation, liquidation or exclusion from the deposit guarantee fund

summaries.en: Where a deposit taker is reorganised or liquidated or is excluded from participation in the deposit guarantee fund, it must make information about this available to its depositors through the channel agreed in their contract on remote financial services, in addition to the standard depositor information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Find out whether a depositor holds funds that belong to other persons and obtain its confirmation
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Noguldījumu garantiju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 118, 18.06.2015.), 5.¹ panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 26.06.2026

titles.en: Find out whether a depositor holds funds that belong to other persons and obtain its confirmation

summaries.en: Before starting a business relationship with a depositor, a deposit taker must find out whether the depositor manages at the deposit taker funds that are due to another person. It takes the steps needed to obtain, before or during the relationship, the depositor's confirmation that it identifies those other persons and keeps records of the funds due to each of them.

instruments.title: Add Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums, Latvia's bank recovery and resolution law
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 16.07.2015.); the act has no entry-into-force provision of its own

titles.lv: Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums
titles.en: Law on the Recovery and Resolution of Credit Institutions and Investment Firms

payload.shortName: Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums
payload.officialRef: Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.)
payload.implementsNote: BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU, with BRRD2, Directive (EU) 2019/879, and Directive (EU) 2024/1174 (among the acts the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a recovery plan, submit it to Latvijas Banka and review it at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.), 5. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā, septītā un devītā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Keep a recovery plan, submit it to Latvijas Banka and review it at least once a year

summaries.en: An institution that is not part of a group under consolidated supervision must draw up and maintain a recovery plan setting out the measures it would take to restore its financial position after a significant deterioration, without assuming any public support, and submit it to Latvijas Banka. It reviews the plan at least once a year and after any change in its legal or organisational structure, business or financial position that could materially affect the plan. The plan names the indicators of financial position at which the measures are taken, the institution monitors them regularly, and it notifies Latvijas Banka without delay of a decision to take a measure under the plan.

payload.refLabel: 5. panta pirmā, otrā, trešā, ceturtā, septītā un devītā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cooperate with Latvijas Banka in resolution planning and give it all the information the plan needs
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.), 12. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Cooperate with Latvijas Banka in resolution planning and give it all the information the plan needs

summaries.en: On a request from Latvijas Banka, an institution must cooperate in the drawing up of its resolution plan and provide all the information needed to draw up and implement the plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish whether the firm is party to an intra-group financial support agreement and update it yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.), 32. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Publish whether the firm is party to an intra-group financial support agreement and update it yearly

summaries.en: A group company registered in Latvia must publish on its website whether or not it has entered into an intra-group financial support agreement, with a description of the general terms of the agreement and the names of the group companies that are party to it, and update the published information once a year in line with Articles 431 to 434 of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Write a bail-in recognition clause into contracts for liabilities governed by third-country law
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.), 76. panta pirmā, ceturtā un piektā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Write a bail-in recognition clause into contracts for liabilities governed by third-country law

summaries.en: When taking on a liability, an institution or financial company must include in the contract a term stating that the liability may be subject to write-down or conversion powers, where the liability is not excluded from bail-in, is not a claim of natural persons or micro, small and medium-sized enterprises above the guaranteed amount, is governed by the law of a third country and arose after the Law entered into force. Where it finds that including the term is legally or otherwise impracticable, it notifies Latvijas Banka, naming the class of liability and giving its reasons, and supplies the information Latvijas Banka asks for; the duty is suspended from receipt of the notification, and Latvijas Banka may require the term to be included if it disagrees.

payload.refLabel: 76. panta pirmā, ceturtā un piektā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Recognise resolution stays in financial contracts under third-country law and keep contract records when required
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kredītiestāžu un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrību darbības atjaunošanas un noregulējuma likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 127, 02.07.2015.), 93.¹ panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Recognise resolution stays in financial contracts under third-country law and keep contract records when required

summaries.en: When concluding a new financial contract governed by the law of a third country, or materially amending one, an institution or financial company must include terms by which the counterparty recognises that the contract may be subject to the powers of Latvijas Banka to suspend or restrict rights and obligations, and that it is bound by a crisis prevention or crisis management measure taken under the Law. Latvijas Banka may also require an institution or financial company to keep detailed records of its financial contracts.

instruments.title: Add Segto obligāciju likums, Latvia's covered bonds law
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 23.06.2021.); the act has no entry-into-force provision of its own

titles.en: Covered Bonds Law

payload.implementsNote: Covered Bond Directive, Directive (EU) 2019/2162 (the directive the act's closing note on EU directives names)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a covered bond programme only with permission from Latvijas Banka and issue only once its conditions are met
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 35. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Run a covered bond programme only with permission from Latvijas Banka and issue only once its conditions are met

summaries.en: An issuer may carry out a covered bond programme in Latvia only after receiving permission from Latvijas Banka. It may start issuing once the conditions in the permission are met, the cover pool has been formed and transferred to the covered bond company, the guarantee agreement between the issuer and the covered bond company is concluded and the other conditions in the law and the programme terms are met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the covered bond programme, the cover pool and the cover assets compliant for the life of the programme
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 40. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Keep the covered bond programme, the cover pool and the cover assets compliant for the life of the programme

summaries.en: Throughout the life of a covered bond programme the issuer must make sure that the programme, the cover pool and the cover assets meet the Law and the programme terms, that a cover pool monitor meeting the Law's requirements is appointed, and that the structural features of the bonds are kept, including the segregation of cover assets from the issuer's assets after the transfer agreement. It keeps a procedure under which cover assets that are tangible property are properly insured against loss, makes sure the board members of the covered bond company follow the Law, and meets the rules on the continuity plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report on the covered bond programme to Latvijas Banka every quarter and at once when the cover pool falls short
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 41. panta pirmā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Report on the covered bond programme to Latvijas Banka every quarter and at once when the cover pool falls short

summaries.en: Once a quarter the issuer must give Latvijas Banka at least information on the assets in the cover pool and its composition, the use of derivative contracts, the cover assets replaced in the previous quarter, the work of the cover pool monitor, compliance with the coverage requirement, the liquidity buffer, any extendable maturity structures, stress testing and its results, and the transactions of the covered bond company. It informs Latvijas Banka without delay when the cover pool no longer meets the Law or the programme terms.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a continuity plan for the covered bond programme and fund its costs for the next 180 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 42. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Keep a continuity plan for the covered bond programme and fund its costs for the next 180 days

summaries.en: The issuer must draw up and put in place a continuity plan with procedures that secure the proper running of the covered bond programme if a special administrator is appointed, covering also what the covered bond company does when the management of the cover pool becomes difficult or another justified obstacle or risk arises. To cover the costs the plan foresees for the next 180 days, including changes to public register entries and the administrator's running of the programme, the issuer transfers the necessary funds to the covered bond company in addition to the liquidity buffer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give investors cover pool information within 20 days of each quarter end and publish it on the website
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 44. panta pirmā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Give investors cover pool information within 20 days of each quarter end and publish it on the website

summaries.en: Once a quarter, within 20 days of the end of the quarter, the issuer must give investors information on the covered bond programme detailed enough for them to assess its profile and risks. It covers at least the value of the cover pool and of the outstanding covered bonds, the list of ISINs, the geographical distribution and type of cover assets and the valuation method, market, interest rate, currency, credit and liquidity risks, the maturity extension structure, the levels of required and available coverage and of overcollateralisation, the share of loans in default or more than 90 days past due, the liquidity buffer and the share of cover assets in foreign currency. The issuer publishes this information on its website for the whole life of the programme.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold cover assets of at least 105 per cent of the nominal amount of covered bonds outstanding
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 55. panta pirmā, otrā un sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Hold cover assets of at least 105 per cent of the nominal amount of covered bonds outstanding

summaries.en: The issuer must make sure that the total outstanding principal of the loan claims included in the cover assets, together with the value of derivatives, is not less than 105 per cent of the total outstanding nominal amount of the covered bonds. The level is at least 110 per cent where the primary assets are loans to, or guaranteed by, companies controlled by a public person that meet the section's conditions. Latvijas Banka may at any time require a higher level where the cover pool is not sufficient to protect investors.

payload.refLabel: 55. panta pirmā, otrā un sestā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold liquid assets in the cover pool that cover the maximum net liquidity outflow of the next 180 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 57. panta pirmā, trešā un ceturtā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Hold liquid assets in the cover pool that cover the maximum net liquidity outflow of the next 180 days

summaries.en: The issuer must make sure that the cover assets always include liquid assets, in money or financial instruments, available to cover the maximum cumulative net liquidity outflow of the covered bond programme over the next 180 days, not counting collateral received from derivative counterparties. The liquid assets are protected like other cover assets, segregated from the issuer's other assets and usable at any time for the purpose. They may be held with the issuer, but on a request from Latvijas Banka they are transferred without delay, within seven days at the latest, to another credit institution licensed in a Member State.

payload.refLabel: 57. panta pirmā, trešā un ceturtā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stress test the cover pool at least every quarter and add cover assets when the test shows a shortfall
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Segto obligāciju likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 110, 09.06.2021.), 59. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 19.07.2023

titles.en: Stress test the cover pool at least every quarter and add cover assets when the test shows a shortfall

summaries.en: The issuer must run a sound, comprehensive and risk-appropriate stress testing process built into its risk management. At least once a quarter it tests, at different levels of financial shock and covering all risks that could materially affect the risk profile of the bonds, whether the cover assets are sufficient to cover the total outstanding nominal amount of the covered bonds. Where the test shows that the statutory level of overcollateralisation is not met, it must add cover assets to the pool until the level is restored under the scenarios applied.

instruments.title: Add Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums, Latvia's Consumer Rights Protection Law, for its consumer credit rules
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 15.04.1999.); the act has no entry-into-force provision of its own

titles.en: Consumer Rights Protection Law

payload.implementsNote: Consumer Credit Directive 2008/48/EC; Mortgage Credit Directive 2014/17/EU; Directive (EU) 2023/2225 on credit agreements for consumers (among the directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put a consumer credit agreement in writing and conclude or amend none between 21.00 and 8.00
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), 8. panta otrā un 2.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Put a consumer credit agreement in writing and conclude or amend none between 21.00 and 8.00

summaries.en: A consumer credit agreement must be drawn up in writing, on paper or another durable medium, and each party given a copy. It is prohibited to conclude or amend a consumer credit agreement between 21.00 and 8.00, unless the rules on consumer credit set stricter limits.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the total cost of consumer credit within 0.07 per cent of the loan amount a day
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), 8. panta 2.², 2.³ un 2.⁴ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Keep the total cost of consumer credit within 0.07 per cent of the loan amount a day

summaries.en: The costs of a consumer credit agreement must be proportionate and consistent with fair business practice, and a total cost of credit to the consumer above 0.07 per cent of the amount of credit a day does not meet that standard. Under an agreement to be repaid within three months, the sum of all credit-related charges, including interest, default interest, penalties, commissions and extension fees, may not exceed the amount lent. Neither limit applies to pawn agreements where the consumer's liability is limited to the pledged item, and the three-month limit does not apply to overdrafts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Schedule distance loans in at least monthly instalments, cap default interest and take no bills of exchange
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), 8. panta 2.⁵, 2.⁶ un 2.⁷ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Schedule distance loans in at least monthly instalments, cap default interest and take no bills of exchange

summaries.en: Where a consumer credit agreement is concluded by means of distance communication, the credit must be repaid in instalments proportionate to the term, interest and principal at least once a month, save for loans of up to one month, overdrafts and card credit, and deferrals for persons in national defence service. A term allowing default interest of more than 36 percentage points a year above the borrowing rate is void, except in agreements secured by a mortgage on immovable property. Bills of exchange may not be set as a means of payment in consumer credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept early repayment with a fair reduction in cost and charge only actual costs for late payment
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), 8. panta trešā un 3.¹ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Accept early repayment with a fair reduction in cost and charge only actual costs for late payment

summaries.en: A consumer may at any time discharge the obligations under a consumer credit agreement in full or in part before the agreed date, and is then entitled to a fair reduction of the total cost of credit, made up of the interest and other costs for the remaining term. For late payment or out-of-court debt recovery the lender may charge the consumer only its proportionate and objectively justified actual costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the consumer's ability to repay before lending and before any material increase of the credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), 8. panta 4.¹, 4.², 4.⁴ un 4.⁵ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Assess the consumer's ability to repay before lending and before any material increase of the credit

summaries.en: Before concluding a consumer credit agreement, and again before agreeing a material increase in the total amount of credit, a lender must assess the consumer's ability to repay from sufficient information obtained from the consumer and, where needed, from databases on income and payment history, and must request, obtain and assess information on the consumer's income and expenses. It may grant the credit only where the assessment shows that the obligations are likely to be met as agreed, tells the consumer at once when an application is rejected and whether the decision was automated, and where the refusal rests on a database tells the consumer the result and the database used free of charge. A lender that lends without the assessment may claim no more than statutory interest and no penalties for late payment caused by the faulty assessment, and the paragraphs do not apply to the kinds of agreement listed in paragraph 4.³.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Exchange data on consumers' and guarantors' obligations with other lenders through credit bureaus
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Patērētāju tiesību aizsardzības likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 104/105, 01.04.1999.), 8. panta 4.⁷ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Exchange data on consumers' and guarantors' obligations with other lenders through credit bureaus

summaries.en: So that lenders can assess a consumer's ability to repay where the information the consumer gave is not sufficient and documented, and a guarantor's ability to meet a guarantee, lenders must exchange with each other through credit information bureaus information on the consumer or guarantor, their obligations and how they have been performed, to the extent sufficient for the assessment.

instruments.title: Add Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums, Latvia's law supplementing the GDPR
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.), consolidated text, the version in force from 04.06.2021; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 05.07.2018.) and in its closing provision, which puts it into force on the day after its promulgation

titles.en: Personal Data Processing Law

payload.officialRef: Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process personal data only on a ground of the GDPR and within its principles
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.), 25. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 04.06.2021

titles.en: Process personal data only on a ground of the GDPR and within its principles

summaries.en: Personal data may be processed only where at least one of the grounds in Article 6(1) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 applies, and special categories of data only on a ground in Article 9(2) or where an external legal act provides for the processing. The principles of Article 5 must be observed, including that data are collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and only to the extent the purposes need, and processing for another purpose is allowed only where it is not prohibited and has a ground or is compatible with the original purpose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Leave out of an access reply what the law forbids disclosing, and name recipients of the last two years
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.), 27. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 04.06.2021

titles.en: Leave out of an access reply what the law forbids disclosing, and name recipients of the last two years

summaries.en: A data subject is not entitled to receive the information of Article 15 of the GDPR where its disclosure is prohibited by the law on national security, defence, public safety and criminal law, or in order to protect public financial interests in tax matters, the prevention of money laundering and terrorism financing, or the supervision of financial market participants, the working of their guarantee schemes, resolution and macroeconomic analysis. The reply may not name the authorities directing criminal proceedings or conducting investigative operations, or other bodies whose disclosure the law forbids. The data subject may obtain the recipients or categories of recipients to whom the data were disclosed in the last two years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Rely on a child's own consent for online services only from the age of 13
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.), 33. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 04.06.2021

titles.en: Rely on a child's own consent for online services only from the age of 13

summaries.en: Where the direct offer of an information society service needs the data subject's consent under Article 8 of the GDPR and the data subject is a child, the child's consent is a valid basis for processing if the child is at least 13 years old. For a younger child the consent must be given by a parent or legal guardian.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Name the controller, its contact details and the purpose on a video surveillance sign
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.), 36. panta trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 04.06.2021

titles.en: Name the controller, its contact details and the purpose on a video surveillance sign

summaries.en: Where a controller uses an information sign to tell data subjects about video surveillance, the sign must state at least the controller's name, its contact details and the purpose of the processing, and indicate where the other information required by Article 13 of the GDPR can be obtained.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep system audit trails no longer than one year unless a rule or the processing requires otherwise
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 132, 04.07.2018.), 37. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 04.06.2021

titles.en: Keep system audit trails no longer than one year unless a rule or the processing requires otherwise

summaries.en: Where a controller is required to keep the audit trails of a system, meaning the recorded data on events such as access, entry, change, deletion and transfer of data, they are kept for no longer than one year after the record is made, unless legal acts or the nature of the processing require otherwise. The controller need not keep information in audit trails only to answer data subjects' requests, and may decline an access request where it no longer holds the audit trails with the information asked for.

instruments.title: Add Par nodokļiem un nodevām, Latvia's general tax law, for the reporting duties of financial institutions
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Par nodokļiem un nodevām (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 26, 18.02.1995.), consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026; entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā ar 1995. gada 1. aprīli) and in its passport on the page

titles.en: Law on Taxes and Fees

payload.implementsNote: DAC, Directive 2011/16/EU, with DAC2, Directive 2014/107/EU, DAC6, Directive (EU) 2018/822, and DAC8, Directive (EU) 2023/2226 (among the directives the act's closing note on EU directives lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each reportable financial account to the State Revenue Service for automatic exchange
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Par nodokļiem un nodevām (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 26, 18.02.1995.), 100. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Report each reportable financial account to the State Revenue Service for automatic exchange

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must give the State Revenue Service, for every reportable account it identifies under the due diligence procedures the Cabinet of Ministers sets, the name, address, jurisdiction of residence, taxpayer identification number and date and place of birth of each reportable account holder and of the beneficial owners of an entity, whether a reliable self-certification of tax residence was given and whether the account is joint. It also reports the account number and type, its own name and identification number, the balance or value at the end of the year or the closure of the account, and the gross interest, dividends, other income and sale or redemption proceeds paid or credited to the account, each amount with its currency.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the further efforts needed to obtain tax identification numbers and birth dates for pre-existing accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Par nodokļiem un nodevām (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 26, 18.02.1995.), 100. panta trešā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Make the further efforts needed to obtain tax identification numbers and birth dates for pre-existing accounts

summaries.en: For a pre-existing reportable account a financial institution need not report the taxpayer identification number or date of birth of the account holder or beneficial owner where it does not hold them. It must take the additional steps needed to obtain them by the end of the second calendar year after the year in which the account was identified as reportable, and whenever it has to update the information on the account under its customer identification and due diligence procedures under the anti-money laundering law.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell clients before reporting that their account data will be sent to the State Revenue Service
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Par nodokļiem un nodevām (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 26, 18.02.1995.), 100. panta sestā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Tell clients before reporting that their account data will be sent to the State Revenue Service

summaries.en: Before it reports to the State Revenue Service, a reporting financial institution must inform its clients of what has to be reported and that their data will be processed and sent to the State Revenue Service under the chapter on automatic exchange of financial account information and for its purpose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report to the State Revenue Service a suspicious transaction that points to a tax offence
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Par nodokļiem un nodevām (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 26, 18.02.1995.), 22.² panta pirmā, 1.¹ un astotā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Report to the State Revenue Service a suspicious transaction that points to a tax offence

summaries.en: An obliged entity under the anti-money laundering law that detects a suspicious transaction of a person resident or registered in Latvia must also report it to the State Revenue Service without delay where it raises the suspicion that the funds are proceeds of a criminal offence against state revenue. It files the report, and the threshold declarations the Cabinet of Ministers requires, through the Financial Intelligence Unit's data receipt and analysis system, and may not tell the client, the beneficial owner or anyone other than the supervisory and control authorities that the information was given.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report by 1 February the residents whose account turnover reached 15,000 euros or cash deposits 7,000 euros
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Par nodokļiem un nodevām (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 26, 18.02.1995.), 22.³ panta pirmā, 1.¹, 1.² un 1.⁴ daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.10.2026

titles.en: Report by 1 February the residents whose account turnover reached 15,000 euros or cash deposits 7,000 euros

summaries.en: By 1 February each year a credit institution or payment service provider must give the State Revenue Service information on its clients who are natural persons resident in Latvia and whose demand deposit and payment accounts, closed ones included, had a total debit or credit turnover of 15,000 euros or more with it in the previous year, or whose payment accounts received cash deposits of 7,000 euros or more. For the first group it reports the name, personal identity number, total year-end balance and total debit and credit turnover, leaving out transfers between the client's own accounts with it, and for the second the name, personal identity number and the total cash paid in.

instruments.title: Add Latvijas Bankas likums, the law on Latvia's central bank and financial supervisor, for its duties on supervised firms
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 06.10.2021.), consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026; entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā 2023. gada 1. janvārī) and in its passport on the page

titles.en: Law on Latvijas Banka

payload.implementsNote: CRD6, Directive (EU) 2024/1619 (the directive the act's closing note on EU law names)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold minimum reserves with Latvijas Banka as the European Central Bank requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 06.10.2021.), 31. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Hold minimum reserves with Latvijas Banka as the European Central Bank requires

summaries.en: Financial market participants subject to the minimum reserve requirements of the European Central Bank must hold minimum reserves with Latvijas Banka in the amount and under the procedure that the Statute of the European System of Central Banks and the European Central Bank set.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay Latvijas Banka the fees that fund supervision, with 0.05 per cent a day on late payments
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 06.10.2021.), 24. pants, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Pay Latvijas Banka the fees that fund supervision, with 0.05 per cent a day on late payments

summaries.en: A financial market participant supervised by Latvijas Banka must make the payments its own sector law provides for, to cover the costs of regulating and supervising the financial market, applying resolution and running the compensation schemes. Latvijas Banka sets the amounts and the procedure, and a late or incomplete payment carries a charge of 0.05 per cent of the unpaid amount for each day of delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare and supply true statistical data to Latvijas Banka
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 06.10.2021.), 66. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Prepare and supply true statistical data to Latvijas Banka

summaries.en: A person that Latvijas Banka has named as a provider of statistical data must prepare and submit true statistical data to Latvijas Banka, in line with the requirements, procedure and deadlines it sets for the kind of statistics or on its reasoned request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Latvijas Banka access, documents and full and true information during a search or inspection
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 06.10.2021.), 57. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Give Latvijas Banka access, documents and full and true information during a search or inspection

summaries.en: During a search or inspection that Latvijas Banka carries out under the Law, a supervised financial market participant and its officers and employees must, on a lawful request, give access to the premises and storage places to be searched and to any document or electronically stored data, provide complete and true information within the time Latvijas Banka sets, hand over the documents or copies requested and confirm the authenticity of printouts and records. Failure carries a fine of up to 700 euros for a natural person and of 1,400 to 15,000 euros for a legal person.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with Latvijas Banka before processing and recirculating euro banknotes and coins
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 06.10.2021.), 43. panta pirmā un otrā daļa, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Register with Latvijas Banka before processing and recirculating euro banknotes and coins

summaries.en: Only a person of the kind named in Article 6(1) of Regulation (EC) No 1338/2001 may act as a cash handler, and it must register with Latvijas Banka before it starts to process euro banknotes and coins and put them back into circulation. Latvijas Banka sets the requirements for the processing, the registration and the reports on the machines used and the volumes processed.

instruments.title: Add Kriptoaktīvu pakalpojumu likums, Latvia's law carrying out the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kriptoaktīvu pakalpojumu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 120A, 21.06.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions (version date 30.06.2024); entry into force read in the act's closing provision (Likums stājas spēkā 2024. gada 30. jūnijā) and in its passport on the page

titles.en: Crypto-Asset Services Law

payload.implementsNote: Supplements MiCA, Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, as sections 1, 3 and 4 of the act state

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Latvijas Banka at once of every material change and of anything that may harm the firm's business
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kriptoaktīvu pakalpojumu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 120A, 21.06.2024.), 5. panta pirmā daļa, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions (version date 30.06.2024)

titles.en: Tell Latvijas Banka at once of every material change and of anything that may harm the firm's business

summaries.en: A person that issues crypto-assets, offers them to the public or seeks their admission to trading in Latvia, or provides crypto-asset services, must inform Latvijas Banka without delay of all material changes, including any circumstance that may adversely affect its further operation and any change in the information it submitted to obtain its authorisation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply to Latvijas Banka for authorisation to provide crypto-asset services and pay the 2,500 euro fee
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kriptoaktīvu pakalpojumu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 120A, 21.06.2024.), 6. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions (version date 30.06.2024)

titles.en: Apply to Latvijas Banka for authorisation to provide crypto-asset services and pay the 2,500 euro fee

summaries.en: A person that plans to provide crypto-asset services and is not already a financial market participant supervised by Latvijas Banka must file an application with Latvijas Banka for authorisation to provide them and pay 2,500 euros for its examination. The same fee applies to an application to offer an asset-referenced token to the public or have it admitted to trading, and a supervised participant pays 1,250 euros for each further asset-referenced token, up to 5,000 euros a year.

payload.refLabel: 6. panta pirmā, otrā un trešā daļa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay Latvijas Banka a yearly fee of up to 0.6 per cent of gross income from crypto-asset services
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Kriptoaktīvu pakalpojumu likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 120A, 21.06.2024.), 6. panta ceturtā un piektā daļa, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions (version date 30.06.2024)

titles.en: Pay Latvijas Banka a yearly fee of up to 0.6 per cent of gross income from crypto-asset services

summaries.en: A crypto-asset service provider authorised under Article 63 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 must pay Latvijas Banka up to 0.6 per cent a year of its gross income from providing crypto-asset services, and no less than 3,000 euros a year. A supervised financial market participant that provides the services under Article 60 of the Regulation pays up to 0.6 per cent of that income, except credit institutions, investment firms, the central securities depository and regulated market operators.

instruments.title: Add Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums, Latvia's law applying DORA and the EU AI Act in the financial market
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 188, 30.09.2025.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; entry into force read in the act's passport on the page (Stājas spēkā: 01.10.2025.) and in its closing provision, which puts it into force on the day after its promulgation

titles.lv: Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums
titles.en: Law on Digital Operational Resilience and the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Financial Market

payload.shortName: Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums
payload.officialRef: Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 188, 30.09.2025.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the digital operational resilience requirements of DORA as a listed financial entity
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 188, 30.09.2025.), 4. un 5. pants, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Meet the digital operational resilience requirements of DORA as a listed financial entity

summaries.en: The digital operational resilience requirements of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 apply to the financial market participants the Law lists as financial entities, among them credit institutions, payment institutions, electronic money institutions, investment firms, investment management companies, alternative investment fund managers, insurers, insurance intermediaries and crypto-asset service providers. The simplified requirements of Article 16 of the Regulation apply instead to the entities section 5 lists, such as small and non-interconnected investment firms and the payment and electronic money institutions of the kind defined in points 2(b) and 2.¹(b) of section 1 of the payment services law.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the requirements of the EU AI Act when using artificial intelligence as a financial entity
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 188, 30.09.2025.), 7. pants, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Meet the requirements of the EU AI Act when using artificial intelligence as a financial entity

summaries.en: The requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 on the use of artificial intelligence apply, within the scope of Article 2 of that Regulation, to the financial entities listed in sections 4 and 5 of the Law and to credit unions. Latvijas Banka supervises compliance under Article 74(6) of the Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Latvijas Banka of every material change that bears on digital operational resilience
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Finanšu tirgus digitālās darbības noturības un mākslīgā intelekta izmantošanas likums (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 188, 30.09.2025.), 9. pants, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell Latvijas Banka of every material change that bears on digital operational resilience

summaries.en: To secure compliance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, the financial entities listed in sections 4 and 5 of the Law must inform Latvijas Banka of all material changes, including any circumstance that may adversely affect the entity's further operation and any change in the information it has given Latvijas Banka.
